target_customer: Restaurants and cafes in Indian metros (SaaS and POS), plus diners through a consumer app
problem: Indian restaurants ran on disconnected tools for inventory, ordering and billing and captured little customer data.
business_model: B2B SaaS and POS subscriptions for restaurants plus consumer dining app and CRM
product_category: Restaurant operating system and dining platform

founders.name: Mainak Sarkar
previous_startups: Eatables (started 2016 with Pritam Khan, outcome not found)
founders.background_notes: Forbes 30 Under 30 per his own profile tagline.

founders.name: Pritam Khan
founders.background_notes: Role as CTO per Outlook Business.

technical_complexity.rationale: Menu, ordering, POS and inventory software is standard SaaS engineering; the hard parts are integrations and reliability in restaurants.

defensibility.rationale: Restaurant software embedded in daily operations creates some switching cost, but many Indian POS vendors offered similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found showing incumbents acting against Explorex; the company reports operating at breakeven on its YC page.

market_need_then: The pandemic in 2020 pushed Indian restaurants toward contactless menus and online ordering, which is the period of founding, but I found no dated source quantifying demand.

identity.voice_and_tone: Positions itself as the memory layer and infrastructure for offline dining (YC page).

brand_strength.rationale: Trade press covers the funding and the product line names (Bridge, Elite, Clyro) but no source covers the brand itself; similar name Explore X exists in trademark records.

pivots.to: Restaurant operating system plus consumer dining app and AI concierge
pivots.why: Not sourced in detail; YC page describes the current ecosystem platform

outcome_analysis: Explorex raised a pre-seed of about 1.5M and a 5M seed in October 2022 after YC and now reports 250 plus partner restaurants, 3M diners and breakeven operations on its YC page. Founders with a prior restaurant startup suggest founder market fit. The company has not raised a priced growth round in public sources and the long-term outcome is open.
notes: Seed of 5M reported by several outlets (Inc42, YourStory, Entrepreneur India, The SaaS News) so counted as verified; pre-seed date not found and is a single-outlet figure. Partner counts conflict (350 vs 1000 in March 2023). Founding year 2019 or 2020 depending on source. No competitors dated near the 2020 batch were found; Petpooja, UrbanPiper are named only in 2022 coverage so are left out of the list. Product names such as Elite app could not be confirmed outside the company description.
